construct_loader_train: construct a training data loader from config with shuffling and drop last enabled
construct_loader_val: construct a validation data loader from config without shuffling for evaluation
construct_loader_test: construct a test data loader from config with test dataset and batch size
detection_collate_batch: collate a detection batch by concatenating bboxes labels and metadata across samples
shuffle_dataset_epoch: shuffle the dataset loader by setting the epoch on the distributed sampler
